name: Lizardmen

unlocks.notes: Konar, Duradel, Nieve, and Chaeldar can assign Lizardmen after this unlock.

Counts for Lizardmen tasks after Reptile got ripped.

variantInfo.name: Lizardman brute

variantInfo.name: Lizardman shaman
notes: Shaman variant with dragon warhammer drop chance.
Requires shaman-specific movement and poison-spit handling.

locationComparison.name: Lizardman Canyon
notes: West and east sides together hold about 38 level 53/62 Lizardmen, plus 28 Lizardman brutes and 3 Lizardman shamans (west side).
Multicombat and cannonable - the common cannon spot for Lizardmen tasks.
The wiki marks these spawns as not safespottable.

locationComparison.name: Lizardman Settlement
notes: 4 level 53/62 Lizardmen and 5 Lizardman brutes at the Lizardman Settlement.
Single-combat and not cannonable per the wiki task table; not safespottable.

locationComparison.name: Kebos Swamp
notes: Kebos Swamp holds 7 level 53/62 Lizardmen and 3 Lizardman brutes.
Single-combat and not cannonable per the wiki task table; not safespottable.

locationComparison.name: Lizardman Caves
notes: Eight shamans in a single-combat cave network. Only the northern entrance is usable. Captain Cleive prevents combat without a Lizardmen Slayer assignment. Cannons cannot be set up. Fairy ring BLS is south of the entrance; Xeric's Lookout and the Graveyard of Heroes are other routes.

locationComparison.name: Lizardman Temple
notes: Six shamans, two per chamber, below Molch. Enter through a one-way lizard dwelling and leave through the south-west strange hole or teleport. Cannons cannot be placed. Repeated barrier crossings cause escalating10/20damage after3/6crossings; each crossing adds a minute to recovery. No Slayer assignment is required.

taskNotes: Lizardmen can only be assigned after purchasing Reptile got ripped for 75 Slayer reward points.
Chaeldar assigns 50-90 Lizardmen after the unlock.
Konar assigns 90-110 Lizardmen after the unlock.
Nieve assigns 90-120 Lizardmen after the unlock.
Duradel assigns 130-210 Lizardmen after the unlock.
Lizardman Canyon is the common cannon task location.
Lizardman shamans are the profit-focused alternative because of the dragon warhammer drop, but they require shaman-specific mechanics.
Shaman poison-spit protection is provided by the dedicated shaman method; Shayzien favour is no longer an access requirement.
recommendedMethod: Requires the Reptile got ripped unlock. Use cannon plus melee or ranged in the Lizardman Canyon for normal Lizardmen tasks, or kill Lizardman shamans when choosing the slower dragon warhammer profit route.
